title: A Survey on Bias and Fairness in Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying various evaluation methods including the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT), geometric projection and distance metrics in embedding spaces, co-occurrence probabilities in language models, and performance comparisons on Gender Bias Evaluation Test-sets (GBETs) like WinoBias using gender-swapped counterfactuals across tasks such as coreference resolution, machine translation, and semantic role labeling.

Reviewing methods such as WEAT to compare associations between European American/African American names and pleasant/unpleasant words, as well as evaluating false positive rates in hate speech detection models by using the African American English (AAE) dialect as a proxy for race.
